The file is written. Note one honesty point: the emitting cell defined `N_PREM`/`order` but never actually consumed them, so **no arity or dependency validation happened yet**. I'll run that as a separate well-formedness check — this validates that the obligations are *statable*, not that they hold.

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
import re

# Reload the obligation file and validate SHAPE only (no discharge, no kernel).
txt = open("sum_eltsub.obl").read()

RULE_ARITY = {"refl":0,"def_elem_nil":0,"def_elem_cons":0,"def_sum_nil":0,
              "def_sum_cons":0,"def_sub":0,"ax_abgrp":0,"assume":0,
              "sym":1,"sum_cong":1,"add_cong":2,"sub_cong":2,"trans":2,
              "induct":2}

obl_pat = re.compile(r"^obl\s+(\S+)\s*\|-\s*(.*?)\s*===\s*(.*?)\s*\n\s*::\s*(\S+)\s*"
                     r"from=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*ctx=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*$", re.S | re.M)
obl = [(m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4),
        [p.strip() for p in m.group(5).split(",") if p.strip()],
        m.group(6)) for m in obl_pat.finditer(txt)]

print("parsed obligations :", len(obl))
IH_S = "(sum (eltsub xs ys)) === (sub (sum xs) (sum ys))"

print("\n--- check 1: rule names known and premise arity matches ---")
seen, bad = set(), []
for (i, l, r, rule, frm, ctx) in obl:
    if rule not in RULE_ARITY:
        bad.append((i, "unknown rule %s" % rule)); continue
    if len(frm) != RULE_ARITY[rule]:
        bad.append((i, "rule %s wants %d premises, got %d"
                    % (rule, RULE_ARITY[rule], len(frm))))
    if rule == "induct":
        if frm != ["B11", "S15"]:
            bad.append((i, "induct premises must be [B11,S15], got %s" % frm))
    fwd = [p for p in frm if p not in seen and p != i]
    if fwd: bad.append((i, "forward/unresolved premises %s" % fwd))
    seen.add(i)
print("  violations:", bad if bad else "none — every premise resolves backward")

print("\n--- check 2: context discipline around the induction ---")
for (i, l, r, rule, frm, ctx) in obl:
    if i == "B11": print("  B11 ctx == ''", "->", ctx == "", "|", repr(ctx))
    if i == "S15": print("  S15 ctx == IH", "->", ctx == IH_S, "|", repr(ctx))
    if i == "F1":  print("  F1  ctx == ''", "->", ctx == "", "|", repr(ctx))

print("\n--- check 3: the four non-structural obligations needing real work ---")
for (i, l, r, rule, frm, ctx) in obl:
    if rule in ("ax_abgrp", "induct"):
        print("  %-4s %-8s  %s  ===  %s" % (i, rule, l, r))

print("\n--- check 4: refinement block is complete and non-overlapping ---")
ref = re.findall(r"^obl\s+(R\d+)\s*\|-.*?::\s*(\S+)", txt, re.S | re.M)
print("  refinement obligations:", [x[0] for x in ref])
print("  distinct rule names    :", sorted({x[1] for x in ref}))
print("  R6 goal == S12 goal    :",
      "R6" in [x[0] for x in ref] and "(add (sub x y) (sub (sum xs) (sum ys)))" in txt)

print("\n--- check 5: no proof/derivation key in the file (obligations only) ---")
for kw in ["qed", "proof", "discharge", "ACCEPTED", "MATCH"]:
    print("  contains %-10s: %s" % (kw, kw in txt))
print("\nRESULT: obligation set is well-formed. 0 obligations discharged.")
```
